entries.name: Omegaverse

The omegaverse is like a wild soap opera for fictional characters. Picture this: Alphas, Betas, and Omegas are the main players. Throw in some fated mates trope, MPreg (male pregnancy), and societal rules that could make your head spin. It's a fascinating, complex universe where biology and social structures collide. Whether you find it intriguing or eyebrow-raising, the omegaverse is one wild ride in the world of fanfiction and creative storytelling. entries.content:
Recessive Omega pregnancy lasts 9 months as is common. Pregnancy is like any other, they experience discomfort, cravings, and on many occasions they become more sensitive.
